citation: Guyon, I., Lemaire, V., Boulle, M., Dror, G., Vogel, D. (2009). Analysis of the KDD Cup 2009: Fast Scoring on a Large Orange Customer Database. JMLR Workshop and Conference Proceedings 7:1-22.
source: Table 2 (page 12) for best results; Section 5 (pages 5-7) for the Naive Bayes and in-house baselines, stated there as LARGE-dataset results
winner: IBM Research (slow track score 0.8521, fast track 0.8493; Table 1, page 10)
caveats: Official results are on the challenge's own test set, whose labels were never released.
Section 7.1 (page 10): all the winning teams scored best on the LARGE dataset (15,000 variables). This project uses the SMALL dataset (230 variables).
Our test AUCs come from our own stratified 20% hold-out of the 50,000 labelled rows, so the comparison is approximate only.
